title: Household Drill Completion Trend
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prep:drill drill_type=* completion_pct=*
| timechart span=1q avg(completion_pct) as avg_completion, count as drills by drill_type
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends quarterly average completion percentage for household emergency prep drills by type.
value: Drill completion trends reveal whether preparedness is a living habit or a one-time shopping spree.
implementation: Log fire, earthquake, and evacuation drills with `completion_pct` and review quarterly averages.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of average drill completion by type.
grandmaExplanation: It spots whether your family is actually practicing emergency drills or just planning to.
